title: Show HN: Real-time Solar System with 526k asteroids and all tracked satellites
summary: A Show HN project presenting a real-time interactive visualization of the solar system, rendering 526,000 asteroids and all tracked satellites. Despite being posted in an AI/ML context, the content is a browser-based 3D astronomy visualization rather than an AI/ML system, drawing 295 points and 73 comments on Hacker News.
